DR-4: sink rows sharing a signature (e.g. subprocess.check_output arg 0) were NOT merged - call-site context (literal vs interpolated arg, shell flag, cwd provenance) determines classification, so each call site keeps its own entry.
DR-5: no exact duplicate (file, line, callable) rows were present in either CSV; nothing was dropped silently.
